name: Approver sees the approval queue with recent decisions

planSteps.description: Sign in as monica.chen@soply.test with password Soply123! (fill the Email and Password fields on /login and click 'Sign in')
The page shows the heading 'Approval queue' with the tabs 'Needs my review' and 'Recently decided'
The 'Needs my review' tab shows a count badge and lists pending Finance drafts such as 'Expense reimbursement' v2 submitted by Jordan Miller
The 'Recently decided' list shows decided draft cards with titles such as 'Expense reimbursement', each showing an Approved or Rejected badge and the approver's name (e.g. 'by Monica Chen')
